morning_starts.title: Huckleberry Roasters
morning_starts.note: Fuel up RiNo-style before the mural crawl — their pour-over is basecamp coffee done right.

morning_starts.title: Little Owl Coffee
morning_starts.note: A LoDo warm-up two blocks from Union Station — perfect launch pad for the day's trailhead.

morning_starts.title: Bakery Four
morning_starts.note: Croissants worth setting an alarm for — carb-load like you're heading uphill, because at 5,280 ft you sort of are.

morning_starts.title: Sam's No. 3
morning_starts.note: A 1920s diner institution — green chile and pancakes to line the stomach before altitude does its thing.

morning_starts.title: Stowaway Kitchen
morning_starts.note: Bright, breezy morning plates in RiNo — hydrate here, the mile-high sun is deceptive.

morning_starts.title: Corvus Coffee Roasters
morning_starts.note: Serious single-origin for the caffeine purists — a South Broadway ritual before you point the car west.

morning_starts.title: Pablo's Coffee
morning_starts.note: Cap Hill's neighborhood roaster — grab a cup and read the city's pulse before the crowds wake.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Adventure Hub at Washington Park Boathouse
beach_lake_outdoor.note: Rent a paddleboard on Wash Park's lakes — flatwater and mountain views, my favorite easy-altitude morning.
beach_lake_outdoor.business: Adventure Hub at Washington Park Boathouse

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Cherry Creek State Park
beach_lake_outdoor.note: A reservoir-and-prairie escape ten minutes from downtown — swim, sail, or just find shade with a Front Range skyline.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Chatfield State Park
beach_lake_outdoor.note: Big-water sailing and beach time at the foot of the foothills — pack sunscreen, that 300-days-of-sun is no joke.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Bear Creek Lake Park
beach_lake_outdoor.note: A swim beach plus paddle rentals with Mount Falcon rising behind — Lakewood's underrated water day.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Confluence Park
beach_lake_outdoor.note: Where Cherry Creek meets the Platte — locals tube and wade right in the heart of the city.

beach_lake_outdoor.title: Clear Creek Whitewater Park (Golden)
beach_lake_outdoor.note: Golden's downtown rapids — tube the chutes or watch kayakers surf the wave with a beer in hand.

culture_history.title: Denver Art Museum
culture_history.note: The Hamilton Building's jagged titanium is a landmark itself — start here for Indigenous art and the city's cultural anchor.

culture_history.title: Denver Museum of Nature & Science
culture_history.note: Dinosaurs, gems, and a rooftop view of the Front Range — City Park's brainy heart.

culture_history.title: Clyfford Still Museum
culture_history.note: One artist, one hushed building — a meditative counterpoint to the DAM next door.

culture_history.title: Molly Brown House Museum
culture_history.note: The 'Unsinkable' Titanic survivor's Cap Hill mansion — Denver's Gilded Age up close.

culture_history.title: Denver Botanic Gardens
culture_history.note: Twenty-four acres of desert-to-alpine plantings — Colorado's ecosystems in one walkable loop.

culture_history.title: Meow Wolf Denver | Convergence Station
culture_history.note: A four-story immersive art trip — surreal, sensory, and unlike anything on the map.

shopping_browsing.title: Tattered Cover Book Store — Union Station
shopping_browsing.note: Denver's beloved indie bookstore inside the grand hall — browse, then people-watch over the platform.
shopping_browsing.business: Tattered Cover Book Store — Union Station

shopping_browsing.title: Capitol Hill Books
shopping_browsing.note: Creaky-floor used bookstore treasure hunt — where Cap Hill loses track of time.

shopping_browsing.title: Twist and Shout Records
shopping_browsing.note: One of the great American record stores — dig for vinyl on Colfax for hours.

shopping_browsing.title: Wax Trax Records
shopping_browsing.note: A Cap Hill crate-digger's institution since the '70s — punk, jazz, and everything in the stacks.

shopping_browsing.title: Topo Designs Flagship Store
shopping_browsing.note: Denver-born packs and mountain gear that look as good on Welton St as on the trail.

shopping_browsing.title: Fancy Tiger Crafts Co-op
shopping_browsing.note: A maker's paradise on South Broadway — yarn, fabric, and DIY Colorado spirit.

shopping_browsing.title: Cherry Creek North
shopping_browsing.note: Sixteen walkable blocks of boutiques and galleries — the city's upscale browse.

casual_lunch.title: Yuan Wonton
casual_lunch.note: The famous food-truck-turned-brick-and-mortar — dumplings that earned every accolade, grab them fresh.

casual_lunch.title: El Taco de Mexico
casual_lunch.note: A Santa Fe Drive counter legend — the green chile smothered anything is a Denver rite of passage.

casual_lunch.title: Stowaway Kitchen
casual_lunch.note: Fresh bowls and sandwiches in RiNo — light enough to keep you moving through the murals.

casual_lunch.title: La Loma
casual_lunch.note: Sky-high margaritas and hand-rolled tortillas downtown — a festive midday refuel.

casual_lunch.title: Brewery Bar II
casual_lunch.note: A no-frills local for fierce green chile — the kind of lunch that fuels an afternoon uphill.

casual_lunch.title: Sam's No. 3
casual_lunch.note: Diner classics any hour — reliable, generous, and pure old-Denver comfort.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Postino Broadway
happy_hour_drinks.note: Bruschetta boards and $5-wine hour on the patio — the golden-hour move on South Broadway.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Historians Ale House
happy_hour_drinks.note: Cap Hill's easygoing tap list with elevated bar bites — settle in as the sun drops.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Ratio Beerworks
happy_hour_drinks.note: RiNo brewery with a rock-and-roll heart — house saisons in a mural-lined garage.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Our Mutual Friend Brewing
happy_hour_drinks.note: Small-batch and neighborhood-loved in RiNo — the local's brewery of choice.

happy_hour_drinks.title: El Five
happy_hour_drinks.note: Rooftop tapas with the best skyline-and-mountains view in town — time it for sunset.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Bierstadt Lagerhaus
happy_hour_drinks.note: Impeccable German lagers in a cavernous RiNo hall — the Slow Pour Pils is worth the wait.

happy_hour_drinks.title: Beacon RiNo
happy_hour_drinks.note: A lively RiNo spot to kick off the night with cocktails before the crowd builds.

dinner_casual.title: Root Down
dinner_casual.note: Farm-to-table in a converted gas station — Highlands soul with global reach, and a killer happy hour rollover.

dinner_casual.title: Work & Class
dinner_casual.note: Latin-American and Southern comfort in a shipping-container room — order the family way and share.

dinner_casual.title: La Loma
dinner_casual.note: New-Mexican classics and those towering margs — a rowdy, warm downtown dinner.

dinner_casual.title: Annette
dinner_casual.note: Wood-fired, seasonal, and family-friendly in Aurora's Stanley Marketplace — a neighborhood gem worth the drive.

dinner_casual.title: Yuan Wonton
dinner_casual.note: Sichuan-leaning dumplings and noodles — casual seating, serious cooking.

dinner_casual.title: Sáp Súa
dinner_casual.note: Vietnamese cooking that's the talk of the town — bright, personal, and endlessly craveable.

dinner_upscale.title: Tavernetta
dinner_upscale.note: Refined Italian by Union Station — handmade pasta and a cellar deep enough to get lost in.

dinner_upscale.title: Mercantile Dining & Provision
dinner_upscale.note: Alex Seidel's market-and-restaurant inside the depot — Colorado ingredients at their most polished.

dinner_upscale.title: Beckon
dinner_upscale.note: A tasting-counter jewel in RiNo — intimate, precise, and one of the city's best seats.

dinner_upscale.title: The Wolf's Tailor
dinner_upscale.note: Boundary-pushing multi-course cooking — house-milled grains and live fire, a true destination meal.

dinner_upscale.title: Margot
dinner_upscale.note: Beckon's sister next door — a warm, ingredient-driven fine-dining room in RiNo.

dinner_upscale.title: Safta
dinner_upscale.note: Chef Alon Shaya's Israeli feast at The Source — pillowy pita fresh from the wood oven, don't skip it.

dinner_upscale.title: Brutø
dinner_upscale.note: A masa-focused tasting menu cooked over fire — inventive and quietly one of Denver's finest.

dinner_romantic.title: Rioja
dinner_romantic.note: Jennifer Jasinski's Mediterranean gem on Larimer Square — candlelit, timeless, a true date-night anchor.

dinner_romantic.title: Tavernetta
dinner_romantic.note: Low light, great wine, and pasta made to share — an easy yes for two.

dinner_romantic.title: Sushi Den
dinner_romantic.note: Fish flown from Japan to a buzzy, intimate Platt Park room — a longtime Denver love affair.

dinner_romantic.title: Barolo Grill
dinner_romantic.note: Northern-Italian elegance and a legendary wine list — the special-occasion classic.

dinner_romantic.title: El Five
dinner_romantic.note: Rooftop tapas with twinkling skyline views — order the paella and toast the mountains.

dinner_romantic.title: The Fort
dinner_romantic.note: A hand-built adobe overlooking the foothills in Morrison — game, history, and sunset romance near Red Rocks.

dinner_romantic.title: Potager
dinner_romantic.note: A menu that changes with the season in a candlelit Cap Hill space — quiet, soulful, and lovely.

nightlife.title: Death & Co Denver
nightlife.note: The vaunted cocktail bar inside The Ramble Hotel — meticulous drinks, RiNo's most stylish nightcap.

nightlife.title: The Cruise Room
nightlife.note: An Art Deco martini bar in the Oxford Hotel, unchanged since 1933 — start the night with history.

nightlife.title: Ogden Theatre
nightlife.note: A historic Colfax venue where the touring greats play — check the marquee and go loud.

nightlife.title: Cervantes' Masterpiece Ballroom
nightlife.note: Five Points' live-music soul, keeping the neighborhood's jazz-into-everything legacy dancing.

nightlife.title: Honey Elixir Bar
nightlife.note: A moody RiNo cocktail den built around honey and botanicals — low-lit and inventive.

nightlife.title: Ophelia's Electric Soapbox
nightlife.note: A gastro-brothel-turned-music-hall with dinner and a dance floor — playful late-night energy.

nightlife.title: Beacon RiNo
nightlife.note: A buzzy RiNo hangout that carries you from happy hour deep into the night.

family_activities.title: Denver Museum of Nature & Science
family_activities.note: Dinosaurs, planetarium, and hands-on halls — the surefire kid-pleaser, rain or shine.

family_activities.title: Denver Botanic Gardens
family_activities.note: Wide paths, a children's garden, and koi ponds — space for little legs to roam.

family_activities.title: Coors Field
family_activities.note: Rockies baseball at altitude — the thin air makes for legendary home runs, catch a day game.

family_activities.title: Meow Wolf Denver | Convergence Station
family_activities.note: A wander-through art wonderland kids and grown-ups both get lost in — pure imagination.

family_activities.title: Rocky Mountain Arsenal National Wildlife Refuge
family_activities.note: Bison, prairie dogs, and eagles ten minutes from downtown — an easy wildlife drive for the whole crew.
family_activities.business: Rocky Mountain Arsenal National Wildlife Refuge

family_activities.title: Union Station Farmers Market
family_activities.note: Snacks, buskers, and open plaza to roam — a relaxed family morning at the depot.

family_activities.title: Amtrak Winter Park Express
family_activities.note: A ski-train straight from Union Station into the Rockies — the ride itself is the adventure.

rainy_day.title: Denver Art Museum
rainy_day.note: Hours of galleries under one dramatic roof — the go-to when the weather window closes.

rainy_day.title: Meow Wolf Denver | Convergence Station
rainy_day.note: Four floors of immersive art — you'll forget it's even raining outside.

rainy_day.title: Denver Museum of Nature & Science
rainy_day.note: Dinosaurs and a domed planetarium — a full dry day for curious minds.

rainy_day.title: Clyfford Still Museum
rainy_day.note: Quiet, contemplative galleries — the perfect slow indoor hour when the sky turns.

rainy_day.title: Tattered Cover Book Store — Union Station
rainy_day.note: Coffee, stacks, and the shelter of the grand hall — settle in and wait out the storm.
rainy_day.business: Tattered Cover Book Store — Union Station

rainy_day.title: Molly Brown House Museum
rainy_day.note: A guided walk through Gilded-Age Denver — history stays dry and fascinating.

rainy_day.title: Death & Co Denver
rainy_day.note: When afternoon storms roll in, duck into this dim cocktail room and let it pass in style.
